original_question: Kalinda is working on a 360 piece puzzle with her mom. Kalinda can normally add 4 pieces per minute. Her mom can typically place half as many pieces per minute as Kalinda.  How many hours will it take them to complete this puzzle?
question_template: {name_female, Kalinda} is working on a {num_digit_1, 360} piece puzzle with her mom. {name_female, Kalinda} can normally add {num_digit_2, 4} pieces per minute. Her mom can typically place {num_frac_1, half} as many pieces per minute as {name_female, Kalinda}. How many hours will it take them to complete this puzzle?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 / ((num_digit_2 + f1 * num_digit_2) * 60)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
